# Fixture documents

Every document a test reads lives here and nowhere else, and every one of them
has a record beside it.

A fixture is a pair. `sheet-with-frozen-panes.xlsx` is the bytes, and
`sheet-with-frozen-panes.md` beside it is the record. The record says what the
fixture is for and where it came from, and a fixture without one fails the suite
rather than being skipped.

    # sheet-with-frozen-panes

    What it is for: a frozen pane above a merged range, which the layout pass
    got wrong before.

    Where it came from: generated by this project, see the command in the issue
    that added it.

Both lines are required and both are checked. What it is for is what a reader
needs to decide whether a change may alter this fixture's expected output. Where
it came from is what a reader needs to decide whether this repository may hold
it at all, which for a document is a licence question and a personal-data
question before it is a technical one. `SECURITY.md` and issue #26 are where the
second half is argued.

The directory is flat. A fixture inside a subdirectory would be one the walk does
not see, and a fixture nothing looks at is a fixture nobody maintains.

This `README.md` is the one file here that is not a record. It is excluded by
name rather than by pattern, so a record cannot be hidden by calling it a readme.

There are no fixtures yet. The corpus is milestone 3 and starts at issue #25.
`docs/test-harness.md` is where the rules above are argued and where the check
that enforces them is named.
